label: a pair of non-sneaker shoes
rationale: Most business-casual dress codes rule out athletic sneakers, and shoes are the first thing people notice in an office.

label: two collared shirts you can rotate
rationale: Two shirts cover a five-day week with one wash, which is the smallest number that actually works.

label: one layer for over-air-conditioned offices
rationale: Offices run cold year-round, and a layer is what makes the same two shirts read as deliberate rather than repeated.
